unmirror-intro.objective: Align the approved intro headline across the supported Web, Android, and iOS experiences without broadening scope.
relevantDecisions: Use exactly: Why all that effort perfecting a reflection no one else sees?
Keep existing navigation, privacy, analytics, and release behavior unchanged.
assumptions: All three platform source trees are present in the fixture.
No deployment or device QA is part of this replay.
changedEvidence: The current starting tree contains inconsistent intro headline copy across platforms.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact approved headline appears in Web, Android, and iOS source.
Focused source tests cover the approved headline.
No release or provider behavior changes.
unmirror-intro.requiredOutput: Implement the smallest source and focused-test change, run the smallest relevant local proof, and report the result.

unmirror-saved-capture.objective: Let users choose whether newly saved photos and silent clips use Actual or Mirror output across Web, Android, and iOS.
relevantDecisions: Default to Actual.
Persist the choice locally.
Apply the selected view to photos and clips.
Keep existing local-only media and explicit save/share behavior.

No provider, store, or deployment action is allowed.

acceptanceCriteria: Web, Android, and iOS expose and persist Actual or Mirror saved-output choice.

riskTriggers: Local media must not be uploaded.
Do not alter camera permission or release behavior.
unmirror-saved-capture.requiredOutput: Implement one coherent cross-platform candidate with focused tests and report remaining device-only limits.

unmirror-native-analytics.objective: Add privacy-limited native analytics parity with explicit enable or disable behavior and safe failure handling.
relevantDecisions: Use allow-listed events only.
Do not capture media, filenames, free text, or person profiles.
A missing provider token must be a no-op.
Users can disable analytics locally.
assumptions: Provider credentials and live provider access are unavailable.
Local deterministic tests are sufficient for this replay.
changedEvidence: The starting tree lacks complete native analytics plumbing and network recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Android and iOS have allow-listed analytics clients.
Missing tokens and disabled preference prevent capture.
Provider/network errors do not break the product.
Tests prove privacy and enable/disable boundaries.
unmirror-native-analytics.requiredOutput: Implement a local-only candidate and tests; do not contact or configure a real analytics provider.

meja-scroll.objective: Keep host actions reachable when the pairing or host interface is taller than a short viewport.
relevantDecisions: Host surfaces may scroll vertically.
Audience display behavior must remain unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria: Host main content allows vertical scrolling when needed.

meja-pairing.objective: Make laptop pairing continuation and exact-session presence resilient to delayed subscription and transient tracking failure.
relevantDecisions: Continue on the same session and selected mode.
Track only the exact session role.
Retry transient presence tracking without duplicate concurrent attempts.
Clean timers and state on unsubscribe.
assumptions: The existing local fake Supabase test surface is available.
No real provider write is allowed.
changedEvidence: The starting tree can lose continuation state and does not reliably recover failed presence tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Laptop continuation preserves session and mode.
Presence waits for subscription.
A failed track retries once the timer fires.
Cleanup prevents stale or duplicate tracking.
Focused tests cover disconnected and connected cases.
meja-pairing.requiredOutput: Implement and test the smallest reliable local candidate without contacting Supabase.
